For lower envs, clone the branch below then OVERLAY the OCI live config — see profile.md + runbooks/fetch-live-config.md. Note: JIRA/client tag is EE, but repo/app names use 'evereve' — same client.

etl.note: No dedicated QA branch — use _upgrade for QA (same as staging). Other branches seen in `git branch` on prod: main, sizerange_code_change (purpose unconfirmed).

config.note: Same branch across all envs — drift lives in the OCI bucket overlay per env, not git. See profile.md OCI bucket table.
